title: Arthur Young, Puharich and the seances with the Nine

tellings.quote: Booharic as well and he was involved in some of those seances with the nine

plain: An inventor named Arthur Young is said to have taken part, along with a researcher named Andrija Puharich, in seances in which people claimed to be in contact with a group of non-human beings called the Nine. Michels mentions this himself, in passing and without naming a source, while talking with the parapsychologist Jeffrey Mishlove. If true, it would mean serious figures of the time were sitting in on claimed contact with otherworldly intelligences.
